messages:
Aisha (Sales): QuantumShield POC kickoff next week. They require SSO (SAML) with some weird NameID variation (contractors via proxy), SCIM for bulk imports (~50k users), and RBAC sync. Pricing question: Hosted vs Dedicated for sustained SCIM load. Need SE + security on thread. @Rach @Nina

Rach (SE): Quick clarification — are contractors using the same IdP issuer as employees or a different SAML provider? If same issuer but different NameID format we can map via claim rules. If different issuer we need aliasing.

Priya (QuantumShield): Contractors come through a lightweight SAML proxy we run. Same enterprise Azure AD for full-time staff, proxy emits different NameID. We will try a sample 50k CSV. Their sync window is ~10 minutes (so peak is ~400 req/s).

Omar (Eng): Implementation notes: we support idmap aliasing (issuer+subject -> internal_id). For SCIM bulk we recommend chunked uploads to our ingest API which publishes to a staging queue and applies idempotent upserts. Example: curl -X POST https://redwood/api/v1/bulk-import -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -F file=@users.csv

Nina (Security): Security considerations: SCIM bearer tokens must support rotation; audit logs retention requested >1yr flagged. If they insist on BYO-KMS or HSM-backed keys and segregated logs we should propose Private. For throughput alone Dedicated is usually better for cost predictability.

Aisha (Sales): Can SE give a ballpark Dedicated commit for sustained 400 rps and daily 50k churn so pricing can be scoped?

Rach (SE): Ballpark: reserved Dedicated with an S1 pool and burst capacity. Expect mid-five-figure USD/month committed depending on retention/SLA. I'll pull exact tier pricing from pricing-ops and update. Note: enabling SCIM pagination (page size 500) will reduce peak pressure.

Omar (Eng): POC config checklist: set name_id_aliases=true, enable scim_chunk_size=500, apply short cooldown on alias writes to avoid DB churn during sync. We'll also add per-tenant throttling.

Priya (QuantumShield): We'll provide a sample Azure metadata XML and a CSV by EOD. For token rotation: our proxy rotates hourly.

Nina (Security): Need to validate hourly rotation with our SCIM auth path. I'll draft security questionnaire answers for encryption at rest (AES-256), KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/BYO), RBAC sync patterns, and logging. If they require HSM or dedicated audit streams recommend Private deployment.

deploy-bot: created ticket POC-7784 "QuantumShield SCIM ingest + NameID aliasing" assigned to eng-platform.

Aisha (Sales): Scheduling 30m sync Tue 10am PT with Priya, Rach, Nina. I'll attach the security questionnaire. Rach will post pricing bucket after ops replies.

Rach (SE): Will follow up with pricing-ops and drop link here.

Priya (QuantumShield): Thanks everyone — see you Tue. We'll try to keep contractor export consistent to minimize alias churn.
